reply:
So the only channel is a landlord who’s already been vague — that makes “get an ETA” harder than it sounded. You can’t text the plumber, so the ask has to go through him.

The cheapest version: Thursday morning, one message to the landlord — “Can you send me the plumber’s number, or have him ring me 20 minutes before he heads over?” That’s not asking the landlord to commit to a time, just to pass a message. Some landlords will do that even when they won’t pin down a window.

If he won’t even do that, then the announcement is doing all the work, and you’re back to reactive — but at least the room knows why you’re stepping out.

Is the landlord the type who answers texts same-day, or does he go quiet?
